# SignWarden

> Local and CI permission/action regression checks against trusted adapters.

- [Start here](README.md): install with `python3 -m pip install .` (Python 3.10+).
- [Input schema](docs/schemas/suite.schema.json): explicit fixtures, steps and expectations.
- [Output schema](docs/schemas/report.schema.json): full report or setup/input error.
- [Case format](docs/case-format.md): adapter operations and effect expectations.
- [Report format](docs/report-format.md): result semantics, exit codes and replay limits.
- [Comparison availability](docs/comparison/index.html): research is exploratory; no independently validated comparison is currently available for publication.
- [Security](SECURITY.md): security@signwarden.com.

Call from the repository root:
`signwarden report --cases cases/sample.json --adapter examples/reference_gateway.py:Adapter --out artifacts/report`

Read the generated JSON, not just process output. Exit codes: 0 PASS, 1 FAIL,
2 UNKNOWN, 3 ERROR. HTTP 200 may contain PASS, FAIL or UNKNOWN.
The operator chooses trusted adapter code; inputs cannot choose a new adapter.
Only controlled effects are observed. No execution sandbox or adapter deadline.
No inferred policy, deployment safety guarantee or claimed advantage over handwritten tests.
Rerunning executes adapter code and may repeat effects in custom integrations.
